title: Clearer confirmations
summary: Questions such as "Discard changes?" or "Delete this?" now open in Lootsplitter's own style instead of a plain browser box, and deleting a campaign has its own Danger zone.
items: Discard questions offer Keep editing and Discard changes; deletions name what is deleted and show it in red.
They work the same on phones, in the Android app, in split view and over other dialogs; Escape or Back cancels and returns you where you were.
Typing a campaign code to delete a shared campaign now says when the code does not match.
In the campaign selector, Delete current campaign moved into a Danger zone fold below New campaign, and the repeated Campaigns heading is gone.
